name: Warmth applies its health buff to the ally a direct heal lands on (#9162)
contract: #9162 reports that Warmth 704563 stopped applying. Warmth is a passive self-aura (Spell.dbc effect 0: APPLY_AURA, aura 42 SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, TARGET_UNIT_CASTER) whose tooltip reads 'Direct healing now increases the target's health by ${$704564m1+$704564ppl1} for $704564d.' The scripted proc in AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp gates on `healing && direct` and casts 704564 on the healed target. 704564 is APPLY_AURA aura 34 SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_HEALTH with TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY, so the buff must land on the ally the heal was aimed at, not on the Sun Cleric. The fixture heals a damaged ally with a direct heal and asserts the 704564 aura appears on that ally. A periodic-only heal must not trigger it, so the discriminating step also checks that a heal-over-time tick alone leaves no 704564 behind.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Warmth passive is active on the Sun Cleric
SETUP: no Warmth health buff is on the ally before any heal
Leave the ally room for the heal
SETUP: the direct heal lands on the ally
DISCRIMINATING: Warmth 704564 lands on the healed ally
DISCRIMINATING: the Warmth health buff is not on the Sun Cleric
